text:
Priya: Quick mobile UX note from session — on very narrow widths the right rail pushes the runs table into horizontal scroll and action CTAs get clipped. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/shot-compact1
Jamie: Repro on iPhone SE. Also saw flicker when keyboard appears on foldable; header jumps because we use 100vh for the table container.
Noor: Yep 100vh is the culprit on foldables/keyboard. Suggest the --vh pattern or visualViewport. Minimal change: set --vh from visualViewport and use calc(var(--vh) - var(--header)).
Noor: Example: ```js
const h = window.visualViewport ? window.visualViewport.height : window.innerHeight;
document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--vh', `${h}px`);
```
Elliot: UX decision: product wants to keep a table for power users when >=390px, but below that collapse to compact cards. For condensed table (390-420) add a sticky narrow actions column with overflow menu so CTAs are always reachable.
Priya: Accessibility: add a skip-to-results link that becomes visible/focusable when the sidebar opens so keyboard users can jump to the first run. Also ensure aria-modal on the rail and aria-hidden on background.
a11y-bot: Recommendation: aria-modal="true" on sidebar, trap focus inside while open, return focus to toggle on close. Add aria-live polite for row counts: announce "Showing X runs" when filters update. Ensure status pills meet 4.5:1 contrast.
Jamie: Copy tweak: change empty state from "No runs" -> "No runs match your filters" and add hint line "Try clearing filters or expanding the date range." Also add microcopy for compact cards to label key fields (Model, Status, Cost).
Noor: Visual affordance: use a subtle right-edge gradient on condensed table to indicate overflow instead of forcing a scrollbar immediately. For compact cards show full labels not ellipses.
Elliot: Implementation plan: (1) --vh change, (2) compact-card breakpoint <390, (3) sticky actions column 390-420, (4) skip link + aria-live. I'll include an a11y checklist and before/after screenshots in the PR.
Priya: QA checklist: iPhone SE, Pixel 7a, Pixel Fold portrait/landscape, VoiceOver, TalkBack, keyboard nav. Please run visual diffs for compact cards.
canary-bot: queued visual job "compact-cards-skiplink-vh" for branch fix/mobile-compact-vh.
Jamie: P2 for next sprint. Tagging design for quick review tomorrow 9:30am. :eyes:
